evidence.note: The float specialization self-strides over blockIndex, guards the current pixel and all four neighbors with imageW/imageH, and uses no block-wide barrier.
The native float launch uses a 16x16 block and passes grid.x plus grid.x*grid.y; the supported variable image domain stays within one such logical block.
pathN gates both flat buffers, non-null d_Input selects the data-dependent sign/center/tail path, and the kernel uses no block-wide barrier.
The native host wrapper launches 128 threads; the supported pathN domain is variable from one through one logical block.
This direct-VConfig registry variant reuses the unchanged vendor kernel body and symbol under a distinct kernel ID.

tid and threadN partition every output position with a blockDim.x*gridDim.x grid stride, so logical blocks 32, 64, and 128 write the same per-position inverse-CND result without shared state or synchronization.
The host wrapper supplies variable N to the native 128-thread launch; the derived registry keeps pathN positive, both flat buffers at least pathN elements, and d_Input non-null.
